title: 管理員審核 API (後端)

commands: npm run lint — no new warnings/errors
findings: GET /api/admin/enrolments returns paginated registrants with user (nameEn, nameZh, email) and course (nameEn, nameZh, iaRefNumber) — supports ?status filter and ?page/?limit pagination
PATCH /api/admin/enrolments/[id] accepts { action: 'APPROVE' | 'REJECT', reason?, receiptNumber? } with Zod validation
APPROVE sets paymentStatus to VERIFIED, stores optional receiptNumber
REJECT sets paymentStatus to REJECTED, stores reason in payerFullName (temporary staging field until schema migration adds dedicated column)
Re-review prevention: returns 409 if paymentStatus is not PENDING_VERIFICATION
Non-admin → 403 (tested via route-level auth check, consistent with POST /api/courses pattern)
evidence.residual: Rejection reason stored in payerFullName (temporary). No S3 presigned URL (S3 infra not available). Both deferred to future PRs.

acceptance: GET /api/admin/enrolments?status=PENDING_VERIFICATION&page=1 — returns paginated enrolments with user + course info
APPROVE sets paymentStatus to VERIFIED, updates receiptNumber with auto-generated sequential number
REJECT sets paymentStatus to REJECTED, stores rejection reason
Admin-only: use middleware role check (only ADMIN role can access)
Payment proof image served via presigned GET URL from S3 (generate temporary download URL)
verification: GET /api/admin/enrolments as ADMIN → returns list with user.nameEn, course.nameEn, paymentStatus. PATCH to approve → paymentStatus=VERIFIED. PATCH to reject → paymentStatus=REJECTED. Non-admin → 403.
